wording_rule: Describe the test split as 'held out from all Phase 4-17 models and decisions', never as 'never opened'.
interpretation_rule: Whatever the clean-test ranking is, no model changes or new training phases follow from it. Every outcome is reported as observed (e.g. pretrained 1.00x best; distilled 0.75x above or below from-scratch 1.00x; results below expectation). The clean test is confirmation, not development.
